llm_response.reason: The website uses a domain (napapijris.com.mx) that mimics a legitimate fashion brand (Napapijri) but instead displays unrelated content for another brand (Acne Studios) in German, with pricing in Euros, and navigation linking to another unrelated Austrian domain. WHOIS records show very recent registration under a name that does not match either brand, with no business legitimacy or clear contact information. These are strong indicators of a fake shopping site designed to defraud customers by mimicking popular brands and likely not delivering any products.
